title: Relay board colors each pipeline role by its state
lead: The relay board's pipeline line colors finished, running and waiting roles separately, and an ended run's summary line colors its outcome, using per-cell color spans in the TUI's panel lines.
findings_note: s294 gate OWNER item, owner chose land + follow-up 2026-10-15

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s294 (owner decision at landing, 2026-10-15) specified that each finished role on the pipeline line is drawn as done. `PanelLine` (`src/slicer/tui.py:183`) carries one style role per line, and the panel draw (`tui.py:1464`) applies `palette.attr(line.role)` to the whole text. So s294 colors the pipeline line and the ended-run lines as a whole. The reviewer marked this low and the owner's call. The owner chose to land s294 and file this follow-up.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `PanelLine` gains optional spans, for example `spans: tuple[tuple[int, int, str], ...] = ()` (start cell, end cell, role). The panel draw paints each span's cells with its role over the line's base role. Every existing `PanelLine` stays valid unchanged. `board_lines` sets spans on the pipeline line (done roles `done`, the running role `started`, waiting roles `dim`) and on an ended run's outcome cell (`done`/`error`).
- `src/slicer/tui_style.py` only if span drawing needs a helper there. Spans count terminal cells (`cell_width`), not characters.
- `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `tests/test_tui.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_BoardLines_Pipeline_SpansColorEachRoleByState`: implementer done, reviewer running, gate waiting give three spans with the roles `done`, `started` and `dim`, over the right cells.
- `test_BoardLines_EndedRun_OutcomeSpan`: a pass and a fail ended run color their outcome cell `done` and `error`.
- `test_Draw_PanelLineSpans_PaintsCells`: with a recording screen, the span cells get the span role's attribute and the rest gets the line's.
- `test_PanelLine_NoSpans_DrawsAsBefore`: a line with no spans draws exactly as now.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the spans to `PanelLine` and the panel draw, then set them in `board_lines`.
3. Update the docs and the CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s296`, branch `feature/s296-board-spans`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
